configurations.//: autoPort is off on purpose. The bridge only accepts WebSocket origins on localhost:5173-5199 and 4173-4199, so a port picked outside that range starts a face that looks perfectly alive and can never reach the brain.
configurations.name: jarvis
configurations.//writes: Append "--", "--writes" here to let JARVIS act — click and type in Chrome, drive the phone, run shell. Left off by default so a fresh clone starts read-only, as the README promises.

configurations.//: The face alone (Vite), for working on the interface without starting the brain. Blades and panels can be pushed by hand from the console through window.__jarvis.
configurations.name: jarvis-face
